skills.detail:
Puts the character in Clear-Clear state and increases own DEF.
While the skill button is held down, damage received from enemies is reduced, and you are able to move.
Deals a mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect as well as a chance to inflict Recovery Block and an ATK debuff after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released.
This attack will remove Clear-Clear state.
Attack ignores obstacles.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.

Clear-Clear State:
Character cannot be seen by the enemy and will not show up on the enemy's mini map.
They cannot be targeted by the enemy or allies.
Clear-Clear state will disappear when receiving damage, when attacking, after capturing Treasure, or after a certain period of time.

Surprise Attack:
Your attack will become a surprise attack when it removes your Clear-Clear state.
